niki.devex: FYI I noticed two DX bugs during onboarding workshop: (1) the python SDK logs a stacktrace when REDWOOD_API_KEY is missing instead of a friendly message, (2) the CLI writes REDWOOD_KEY into .env.example which differs from docs. both lead to confusion.

parth.sdk: thanks. about the stacktrace, it's because we throw on missing creds in init. Should return a clear ConfigError. easy fix. also unify env names to REDWOOD_API_KEY; will add deprecation warnings for REDWOOD_KEY.

elaine.sec: security note: make sure error messages do not echo keys or file paths that might leak secrets. Use generic hints like "no credentials found; set REDWOOD_API_KEY or pass apiKey to the client".

infra-janitor: small infra note: some deploy scripts rely on REDWOOD_TOKEN being present in CI. we should provide a short migration doc for CI admins and a sample GitHub Actions snippet that reads secrets into REDWOOD_API_KEY.

niki.devex: can we also add a validation that if both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_TOKEN exist with different values we warn and prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY, not silently pick one.

parth.sdk: sure. plan: change behavior to: if multiple auth sources detected and values differ -> log a single WARN with suggestion to consolidate and prefer explicit constructor param > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_TOKEN > file. Also include onAuthFailure hook for rotation.

elaine.sec: rotation defaults: for long-lived keys, encourage manual rotation with the rotate endpoint; for short-lived keys, SDK can auto-refresh using provided refresh callback. Also add audit header with requester id when rotating.

rotbot: scheduled: post "rotate tokens older than 45 days" to #security on Friday.

parth.sdk: I'll open two PRs: one for python SDK error hygiene and one for deprecating REDWOOD_KEY in favor of REDWOOD_API_KEY. adding tests for messages not leaking secrets.

niki.devex: i'll update sample-apps workshop docs and the onboarding checklist and add a troubleshooting blurb for "missing creds". please tag me in PRs.

infra-janitor: i'll update our CI snippets and add a migration script that rewrites env var names in build pipelines (opt-in).

niki.devex: perfect. closing this thread. :sparkles:
